description: Builder sample king_of_the_hill: zone marker, per-second score, finish

steps.script:
-- King of the Hill
--
-- Demonstrates a zone marker, per-second scoring and a score-based finish.

local target_score = 15
local zone_radius = 80

local center = { x = 0, y = 0 }
local held_for = 0

function on_start()
  local world = lb.world()
  center = { x = world.width / 2, y = world.height / 2 }
  lb.spawn_marker(center.x, center.y, "HILL", "goal")
  lb.log("Hold the hill. One point per second, first to " .. target_score .. ".")
end

function on_tick(dt)
  local me = lb.player("p-local")
  if me == nil or lb.is_finished() then
    return
  end

  local dx = me.x - center.x
  local dy = me.y - center.y
  if dx * dx + dy * dy > zone_radius * zone_radius then
    return
  end

  held_for = held_for + dt
  while held_for >= 1.0 do
    held_for = held_for - 1.0
    lb.add_score("p-local", 1)
    local score = lb.player("p-local").score
    lb.log("Hill score: " .. score)
    if score >= target_score then
      lb.finish("p-local")
      return
    end
  end
end

lua_logs.text: Hold the hill. One point per second, first to 15.
